findings.observation: The frozen analyzer is executable and the Skill gives a stdin-only path, but the plugin was intentionally not installed, so a recruiter-facing Codex invocation was not observed.
findings.user_impact: The deterministic packet can be useful while the actual effort to supply content and inspect the result in Codex remains unknown.
findings.recommendation: After integration installs the frozen plugin, run one blind recruiter-style invocation and record steps, correction burden, and whether the Skill returns the analyzer packet unchanged.
findings.verification: A fresh installed-plugin task completes TS-CORE-01 from supplied content, preserves all four evidence spans, and returns one prepare_question proposal without manual schema repair.

findings.observation: The deterministic analyzer recognizes the frozen English phrase patterns and safely stops on unrecognized content; broader recruiter phrasing has not been tested.
findings.evidence: commit 3a90594; plugins/talent-signal/skills/analyze-candidate-signal/scripts/analyze_conversation.py sha256 01677116851f28ba7e1e592551cad2b658d8ccc53aa1034665bcef31c35c6ca1; fixture-results.json reports 8/8 frozen cases plus 3/3 supplemental boundary probes
findings.user_impact: A recruiter may receive a truthful no_action or clarification for a relevant signal phrased outside the current rules, limiting usefulness without creating an unsafe effect.
findings.recommendation: Measure abstention and missed-signal rates on an independently authored, synthetic paraphrase set before expanding the extraction rules.
findings.verification: A versioned paraphrase set reports per-field recall and critical-error rate while every unsupported phrase remains proposal-only or abstains.

strengths: All eight frozen cases produce the expected disposition, evidence-backed proposed state, and one action proposal or no_action.
TS-CORE-02 treats no_action as a successful result and creates no follow-up work.
The action artifact is specific, recruiter-owned, time-bounded, and explicitly has no execution authority.
missing_evidence: No installed Codex plugin invocation or recruiter observation.
No interruption, return-after-a-day, or correction-burden evidence.
No field evidence that this reduces work compared with the recruiter's manual fallback.
open_questions: Will Codex reliably pass supplied content over stdin and return the analyzer JSON unchanged after installation?
